record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, shorten only the causal pooling half-life from three interactions to 2.5, retaining readout 0.8*h_t+0.2*m_t. The earlier improvement from four to three motivates testing slightly faster decay without increasing pooling strength, which regressed. Exclude padding and future states, and use the final real position at inference. Preserve truncation, features, embeddings, GRU topology, scoring, loss and optimizer; synchronize predictor metadata.
